subject: Re: Saturday visit?
text: I've been thinking about the visit again, and the original slot is getting tight for everyone. Could we try moving it to Thursday afternoon instead? That would give the volunteers a little more room to set up without feeling rushed. If Thursday doesn't work, Friday morning could also be possible, though it might be busier near the entrance. Let me know which option feels easiest for the team. I can check the keyholder schedule either way. Thanks for being so flexible with this. It means a lot, especially with so many things changing this week. A new reminder will go out once we choose. I appreciate you checking.
